articles.title: Republican primary candidates battle for Bell County Justice of the Peace, Precinct 1
articles.excerpt: Duffield is not seeking re-election; Patrick Patterson and Joseph Agee ran in the March 3, 2026 Republican primary to succeed him (Feb. 14, 2026).

articles.title: Patterson leads Justice of the Peace Precinct 1 race; Sapp, Tice lead four-way JP race
articles.excerpt: Duffield will finish his eighth term and serve through Dec. 31, 2026 (Mar. 3, 2026).

articles.title: Bell County rings in new year by swearing in elected officials
articles.excerpt: Bell County's elected officials, including its justices of the peace, were sworn in on Jan. 1, 2025.
